summary: Facepalm: No facepalm candidate met the rules today, so I'm submitting none. Search results were thin for the Nov 14–20 window. The only possible lead, the Chicago self-cleaning toilet story, couldn't be confirmed. Genius: One candidate found: the 2026 National Book Awards. I ran a limited number of searches. Voyager 1 is already on the bench, so I did not re-propose it. Most other leads were ScienceDaily reposts or had no second accepted source. No facepalm story met the standard; nothing published. The verified genius story is on the bench for a later day.

candidates.reason: passed every check; kept for a later day because the other side had no story
